rollups.text: Calvin’s Japan-related experiences and plans: planned a first trip to Japan in April 2023, staying for a few months before Boston (2023-03-23); planned to explore the city, try local food, and possibly collaborate with musicians (2023-04); attended a Tokyo music festival and met music-industry people (2023-04-20); planned and performed in Tokyo during May, including touring with Frank Ocean (2023-05; 2023-05-22..2023-05-28); said he had never visited the mountains and considered skiing (2023-06-09..2023-06-21); described a Japanese mansion as his home and worked on its recording studio (2023-07-07..2023-07-21); said he had enjoyed Japan and its people and wanted to return (2023-09-22); visited Tokyo, including Shibuya Crossing, and planned to revisit Shinjuku and try its food (2023-10-19); planned another Tokyo trip after his tour (2023-11).

Calvin’s Boston plans and experiences: planned to travel to Boston after his Frank Ocean tour and was interested in its music scene (2023-04-20); looked forward to performing there and exploring the city (2023-05-31); anticipated visiting in July (2023-06-09); booked a Boston flight during 2023-08-26..2023-09-01 and planned to meet Dave (2023-08-26..2023-09-02); visited Boston sights with a high-school friend (2023-10-24); met Boston artists about collaborations (2023-10-03); performed in Boston and invited an old high-school friend (2023-11-13); attended a Boston gala and met an artist (2023-11-16); accepted an invitation to an upcoming Boston show (2023-11-17).

Calvin’s music performances and touring: performed with other musicians (2023-08-02); described a Tokyo concert where the audience sang along (2023-08-14); performed at a Tokyo festival and connected with its crowd (2023-08-22); completed a tour with energetic audiences (2023-08-31); toured with Frank Ocean (began by 2023-10-19); said the tour was incredible (2023-10-23); performed in Boston (2023-11-13).

Calvin’s music projects and creative work: wrote new tunes and attended studio sessions (week of 2023-03-19..2023-03-25); received a producer’s advice to keep his sound unique at a Tokyo festival (2023-04-20); worked on collaborations with Japanese artists (2023-07-07); transformed a Japanese mansion into a recording studio and experimented with genres and electronic elements (2023-07-21); filmed a new album video on a Miami beach (2023-08-26..2023-08-27); released an album (2023-09-11); met Boston artists about new music (2023-10-03); had several collaborations and said an album was nearly finished (2023-10-29); celebrated his album at a gathering in his Japanese house (2023-10-26..2023-11-01); made a beat for a young artist and supported young musicians (2023-11-13).

Calvin’s cars: bought a luxury car, described as a smooth and powerful dream car (2023-03-26); shared photos of a red sports car and described hard work and pride in owning it (2023-03-25..2023-09-22); identified a car as a Ferrari and took it for servicing (2023-08-03); said he got a new Ferrari the prior week and shared a black sports-car photo (2023-10-08..2023-10-14). The records do not establish whether these references concern the same car or separate cars.

rollups.text: Calvin’s cars-and-driving interests: said long drives helped him relax and clear his head (2023-05-03); said fixing cars was calming and satisfying (2023-05-31); took his Ferrari for servicing and visited a Ferrari dealership (2023-08-03); said he enjoys working on cars and shared an orange car project photo (2023-10-04); said he wanted to try car restoration (2023-10-23); said he was interested in cars and making new, powerful models (2023-10-25).

rollups.text: Calvin’s musical instruments: received a gold necklace with a diamond pendant from another artist (2023-05-01); had a custom octopus-decorated guitar made by a Japanese artist friend, representing his love of art and the sea (2023-08-31); customized another guitar with a shiny purple finish to match his style (2023-08-31).

Calvin’s stated music and entertainment interests: liked Aerosmith (2023-03-26); identified Ratatouille as a favorite movie and its dream-following theme as meaningful (2023-09-15); recalled listening to “California Love” by Tupac and Dr. Dre (2023-09-22); watched music videos, concerts, and artist documentaries for inspiration (2023-11-02); agreed classic rock had a major impact on music (2023-11-02).

Calvin’s Japan trip and return plans: on 2023-03-23 he said he had never been to Japan and planned to travel in April, stay for a few months, then go to Boston; his agent found him accommodation. By 2023-04-20 he had attended a Tokyo music festival. He planned a Tokyo performance in May (2023-05), and performed there with Frank Ocean’s tour during 2023-05-22..2023-05-28. On 2023-07-07 he described his Japanese mansion and collaborations with local artists; on 2023-08-14 he described exploring his new place after a Japan tour show. By 2023-09-22 he said the Japan trip had been incredible and he wanted to return; on 2023-10-19 he discussed Tokyo sights and food and planned to return after touring in November.

Calvin’s music album work: he met with the album creative team on 2023-06-08; by 2023-07-21 he was converting a Japanese mansion into a recording studio and experimenting with genres and electronic elements. He began shooting an album video during 2023-08-26..2023-08-27, and reported the album released on 2023-09-11. On 2023-10-29 he said his album was almost finished after several collaborations, and during 2023-10-26..2023-11-01 he hosted a gathering to celebrate his new album. These references may concern different album stages or releases; the records do not resolve the apparent chronology.

Calvin’s Frank Ocean collaboration and touring: Calvin said the collaboration began after they met at a festival in August 2022, clicked, and developed strong onstage chemistry. By 2023-04-20 Calvin referred to finishing the Frank Ocean tour before going to Boston; he performed with Frank Ocean in Tokyo during 2023-05-22..2023-05-28. On 2023-08-22 he said he had met Frank at a Tokyo festival and recorded a song together at Calvin’s mansion, and had secured a deal to continue collaborating. On 2023-10-19 he said he had started touring with Frank Ocean; by 2023-10-23 he described the tour as incredible. The records do not clarify whether the tour references describe one continuous tour or separate tour periods.

Calvin’s home-flood recovery: between 2023-05-09 and 2023-05-15 his place flooded; he saved his music equipment and favorite microphone and remained positive. By 2023-05-16 he was waiting for insurance to take effect before beginning repairs and was eager to resume making music afterward. Elapsed time from the flood period to the recorded insurance-wait update was about 1 week.

Calvin’s car accident and repair: he had a minor accident on 2023-06-16; no one was hurt. By 2023-06-21 he had completed the insurance process and was getting the car repaired. By that date the car had been repaired at a shop; he said sorting everything out took about one week, and he was eager to drive again. On 2023-07-07 he said the repaired car was running well and he was enjoying cruising. Elapsed time from accident to the first repair update was 5 days; the repair and administrative process took about 1 week.

Calvin’s Boston trip and performance: he planned to visit Boston in July 2023 and hoped to explore the city; during 2023-08-26..2023-09-01 he booked a flight and planned to meet Dave. On 2023-10-24 he visited Boston sights with a high-school friend. On 2023-11-13 he performed in Boston and invited an old high-school friend. Elapsed time from booking the flight to the documented Boston sightseeing was approximately 7–8 weeks.

Calvin reported two car-related service or repair episodes in 2023: repairs after a minor accident on 2023-06-16, completed by 2023-06-21 and running well by 2023-07-07; and Ferrari servicing on 2023-08-03. The records do not establish whether the serviced Ferrari was the repaired accident car.

Calvin’s plans and descriptions of Japan changed from anticipation of a first-ever visit (2023-03-23) to reporting Tokyo festival attendance and performances (2023-04-20..2023-05-28), then describing Japan as an experience he had enjoyed and wanted to repeat (2023-09-22); by 2023-10-19 he was discussing specific Tokyo sights and food and planning another visit. He therefore moved from never having visited Japan to returning there within about six months.

Dave repeatedly spent time outdoors in parks and natural settings. On 2023-03-23 he described a calming park with a lake and boats (D1:16); on 2023-06-02 he strolled in a Boston park (D8:6); on 2023-06-09 he shared a pond-and-boat photo and said he explored parks on weekends to relax (D8:2, D8:4, D8:6); and by 2023-07-07 he had regular peaceful riverside walks with friends (D10:3, D10:5, D10:7).

Dave took up photography by 2023-10-29 and photographed Boston scenery, including a sunset skyline and a clock tower in September 2023 (D27:2, D27:4, D27:6, D27:8, D27:10). In November 2023 he bought a vintage camera (D30:5, D30:7), photographed a sunset wave on 2023-11-17 (D30:8, D30:10), and photographed a nearby-park waterfall during 2023-11-10..2023-11-16 (D30:13, D30:14, D30:15). He especially enjoys photographing nature, sunsets, beaches, and waves (D30:8, D30:9, D30:11, D30:12).

Dave joined a rock band by 2023-06-21 and practiced guitar with the other members (D9:18). By 2023-09-14 the band was jamming in a rehearsal session (D19:1, D19:3). On 2023-11-02 Dave said he had long been a fan of the band and had the opportunity to join it; he shared its guitar-themed logo (D28:22, D28:24).

Dave’s car-restoration and engineering path: as a child he became fascinated by cars, including a first car show with his father at age 10 (D26:6), and he described an early repair that turned a neighbor’s broken-down car into a running one (D25:15). He restored a car with his father during one summer as a child (D12:2, D12:4), and restored a classic car in 2022 (D4:7, D4:9). By 2023-05-01 he had opened a car maintenance shop and aimed to work on classic cars (D4:1, D4:5); during 2023-05-08..2023-05-14 he said he opened his own shop (D6:8). On 2023-05-03 he was working with a local garage and planned to keep learning auto engineering, with a custom car as a future goal (D5:1, D5:3, D5:5). On 2023-08-11 he was selected for a car-modification workshop, had done engine swaps and suspension modifications, and was learning body modifications (D13:1, D13:3, D13:7). He attended a restoration workshop in San Francisco by 2023-08-14 (D14:1) and returned with car-modification knowledge by 2023-09-01 (D17:1). He restored a vintage classic car by 2023-09-15 (D19:7, D19:8), encountered a strange engine noise while working on his vintage Mustang on 2023-09-22 (D20:1), and had finished restoring a car by 2023-10-29 (D27:9, D27:10).

Dave’s stated music taste shifted or broadened across records: on 2023-03-26 he identified Aerosmith as his favorite band (D2:10); by 2023-11-02 he said he had lately been exploring classic rock and finding new tunes (D28:40, D28:42).
